briefdescription.para: EigenM2 namespace Eigen3-backed SVD / eigenvalues / eigenvectors / least-squares for DMat<R> over RR, CC, RRR, CCC.

detaileddescription.para: Declares aliases LMatrixRR, LMatrixCC, LMatrixRRR, LMatrixCCC over the four DMat<R> instantiations the engine cares about for numerical linear algebra, then a namespace EigenM2 of free-function wrappers SVD, SVD_divide_conquer, eigenvalues, eigenvalues_hermitian, eigenvectors, eigenvectors_hermitian, least_squares that operate on those DMat pointers. Each routine returns bool so the engine can surface convergence failures to the M2 user.

All implementations live in eigen.cpp and call into the Eigen3 template library (Eigen's JacobiSVD / BDCSVD / EigenSolver / SelfAdjointEigenSolver, plus mpreal-backed scalars from <unsupported/Eigen/MPRealSupport> for the MPFR-precision RRR / CCC cases). The RR / CC implementations are guarded by #ifdef NO_LAPACK: by default mat-linalg.hpp skips this header and routes hardware-precision SVD / eigen queries to Lapack:: directly; the RRR / CCC overloads are always built. Interval rings RRi / CCi are not yet plumbed through here.
